required_actions: Select More at the top right, then Settings, then Accessibility (critical)
Select Add languages next to Manage languages for a language other than English (critical for Spanish)
Chrome downloads the language pack automatically (informational)
Select the down arrow next to Preferred caption language and choose the language (critical)
Captions appear in a bubble that can be dragged (what the user sees)
Wait up to 48 to 72 hours after a large deletion for the storage total to update (non-critical)
If still full, check whether photos and videos are set to back up automatically (critical)
Turn off automatic backup on the user's computer, with a starting point and path (critical)
reasons: The user said they are on a computer. The last assistant turn names the fix, 'Automatic backup can be turned off', but gives no starting point or path for doing it on a computer, so the turn-off action is named and not actionable (S1 1, S4 1). The cited Storage Manager page (support.google.com/googleone/answer/9776477) says it does not state whether backup can be turned off on a computer or where, and only refers to a separate article. The second official page checked (support.google.com/photos/answer/6193313) gives turn-off steps only for Android phones and tablets, and does not say what happens to queued files when backup is turned off. Nothing in the sources can complete this step for a computer, and round 3 is the last allowed re-review, so the example is rejected. The Storage Manager steps (one.google.com, Storage, Clean up space, Delete, Permanently delete) and the 48 to 72 hour wait are supported and were not the problem.
